Today the United States and the Philippines began Balikatan, their biggest joint exercise ever. More than 17,000 troops are involved, about 10,000 American. Japan is participating as an active partner for the first time, alongside Australia, Canada, France and New Zealand. The drills run from April 20 to May 8 and include maritime strikes, air and missile defense, and a live fire sinking exercise using Japan's Type 88 anti ship missile and the Philippines' BrahMos batteries.

One detail matters most. Washington and Manila will hold maritime strike drills on Itbayat, only 155 km from Taiwan. Another live fire exercise takes place in Zambales, about 230 km from Scarborough Shoal, which China controls. Beijing says this creates division. Nonsense. What creates division is trying to turn every disputed reef into a Chinese checkpoint. This is what deterrence looks like.
